ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (dark grey/black) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels; high-intensity pixels are predominantly localized at the distal lateral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous regions occupy the outer 20-25% of both the left and right lobe tips. These regions contain high-frequency dark focal spots (mottling). The central 60% of the visible surface is a continuous low-intensity (black) region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees; notch depth is approximately 5% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, variable-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge; most pronounced 'peaks' are observed on the upper-outer margins of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges tapering to acute tips; trailing edge exhibits a moderate sigmoidal curve from the notch to the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular dark pixel clusters (diameter 5-15 pixels) concentrated within the white regions at both fluke tips; several isolated circular 'halo' marks visible in the dark central-right region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of approximately 4-6 faint, diagonal linear streaks of slightly higher intensity than the background dark region, primarily on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring/pitting on the distal margins indicative of past barnacle colonization; small 'nicks' or irregularities in the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique salt-and-pepper transition zone where the high-intensity tips meet the low-intensity central fluke body.
